emailForConfirmation: Check your email; we will send the confirmation there.
rucInvalid: The RUC has 11 digits and starts with 10, 15, 17 or 20.
travelerFullName: Enter the full name as it appears on the document.
termsRequired: To pay, accept the Terms and conditions and the Cancellation policy.
ceInvalid: The foreigner ID card has 9 to 12 letters or numbers.
passportInvalid: The passport has 5 to 20 letters or numbers.
otherDocInvalid: The document has 3 to 20 letters or numbers.
phoneIntl: Enter a valid phone number, with the country code if it is not from Peru (+1…).
addressRequired: Enter your address (street, district and city).
goodDescriptionRequired: Describe the service or product (for example, the tour and the date).
bookingCodeFormat: The booking code looks like PWT-2026-000123 (optional).
declaredTypeRequired: Choose whether it is a claim or a complaint.
detailRequired: Tell us what happened (at least 10 characters).
consumerRequestRequired: State what you are requesting (at least 5 characters).
conformityRequired: Tick the statement of conformity: it replaces your signature.
emailMismatch: The email addresses do not match.
guardianFullNameRequired: Enter the name of the parent or legal guardian.
amountFormat: Enter the amount with up to 2 decimals (e.g. 450.00).
amountRequired: Enter the amount claimed (it can be 0 if there is no amount).
summaryTitle: {count, plural, one {Check this field to continue:} other {Check these # fields to continue:}}
